messages:
priya: Woke up to a page for ROUTE /v1/chat high error rate (INC-559). Posting summary here while I triage. Anyone on primary tonight?

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-559  High error-rate detected on hosted-api (route:/v1/chat). Alert rule: errors/1m > 3% (5m). Pager: eng-oncall.primary. Link: https://redwood/inc/559

tom: I'm primary until 03:00 UTC. Li is secondary. Priya, thanks for grabbing it. Quick question: do we page security for high 500s or only for auth anomalies?

priya: I can hold initial triage. Initial checks:
- errors are mostly 502/504
- p95 latency climbed but CPU/GPU look normal
- several timeouts talking to runtime-backend pods

li: If runtime-backend timeouts, runtime-oncall should be paged first. If we see node-level network drops, escalate to infra. Security only if we see suspicious request patterns or credential failures.

runtime-oncall: Ack. We're looking at runtime side. Can you dump a sample of failed request IDs?

priya: Pasting sample ids and a short trace (sanitized):
```
req: a1b2c3 - upstream timeout to runtime-backend-07
req: a1b2c4 - upstream 504 after 10s
req: a1b2c5 - gateway 502 from runtime-proxy
```

runtime-oncall: Thanks. We're seeing increased tail latencies on runtime-proxy 07. We just rotated a new build last night; investigating regressions in connection pool.

infra-oncall: Not seeing node reboots. Network egress from that AZ had a brief spike at T-7m but no long drops. Storage latency normal. If runtime-proxy is leaking connections we can scale the pool and bounce the failing pod.

priya: Proposed mitigation sequence:
1) runtime: scale runtime-proxy replicas + restart pod-07 (safe rolling restart)
2) infra: observe networking metrics and be ready to cordon node if issues persist
3) support: prepare customer note if errors > 30m
4) security: not paged unless we see unusual auth headers or token churn

support-oncall: I'll draft a short status message for affected customers (latency/errors; investigating). Keep me posted on ETA.

runtime-oncall: Scaling runtime-proxy to +3 replicas now and starting rolling restart of pod-07.

priya: After scale & restart: error rate dropped from 4.2% -> 1.1% over 2 mins. p95 down about 40%. Good sign.

ops-bot: ACTION TAKEN  runtime-oncall scale event recorded.

li: Great. Two operational notes for handoffs: we had an 01:000:30 UTC coverage mismatch last week (primary changed but secondary didn't get notified). Can we add an explicit handoff announcement to the rota so the person becoming primary posts in #eng-oncall?

tom: Agree; I'll make a quick change in the rota playbook. Also adding explicit routing table to the runbook:
- runtime-oncall: model execution, runtime proxies, KV cache behavior
- infra-oncall: nodes, networking, storage, cloud infra
- security-oncall: auth/signature anomalies, secrets access, suspicious API keys
- support-oncall: customer comms, billing impact, SLA questions

priya: One cross-team routing edge-case: if we suspect a model-specific slowdown (e.g., a newer model shard introduced expensive attention pattern), do we page runtime-only or also PM/research? We had confusion last time.

runtime-oncall: Page runtime and include model name/shard info. If it's a model regression (perf after deploy), tag research/ops and set severity accordingly. For immediate mitigation runtime can pin traffic to previous model revision via route header. Example command:
```
# pin model for a subset
route: X-Model-Override: model-v2
traffic: 5% canary
```

priya: Good. Security note: I checked logs for abnormal auth attempts around the incident window; none found. Security-oncall stands down.

security-oncall: Confirmed. No token churn or anomaly in auth logs. If anyone sees unusual 401 patterns, page us immediately.

li: For the handoff tonight: Tom remains primary until 03:00 UTC, Li secondary. Priya will handoff to Tom in 10 minutes. Action items:
- Tom to update rota announcement when he becomes primary
- Li to monitor infra dashboards for the next hour
- Runtime to follow up on root cause of connection pooling in next-day postmortem

priya: Handing off to Tom now. Notes appended to incident ticket.

tom: Im primary now. Thanks Priya. I'll follow up with runtime tomorrow AM for a deeper dive. Also opening a small oncall coverage ticket to ensure the 01:000:30 mismatch gets fixed.

support-oncall: Customer note queued and ready to send if error-rate rises above 2% for 30m.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-559  mitigated. Error rate reduced. Please update incident with RCA and any follow-ups.

priya: Thanks all. Quick recap for the record: routing clarified (runtime->infra->security->support), mitigation sequence executed (scale + restart + canary pinning option), handoff performed, and follow-ups created for runbook update and pooling regression.

li: Closing the thread. If this regresses ping @runtime-oncall first.
